description: Main-window capability: opening a licence's source page - one host, https - in the reader's own browser, plus the two argument-free window commands that let the title bar row drag and double-click-zoom the window it lives in. Importing a file into the composer needs none of it: the file comes from a drop or a file input through the browser File API, which hands the page its bytes and never its path, so no filesystem or dialog permission exists for it; nor does opening a link, which the Engine fetches, returning the bytes to the page; nor does Export need one, since the Engine writes every Export into the one audio folder the Rust side names for it at launch and the page never sees or supplies a path; Tauri's own drag-and-drop handler is off for the window (dragDropEnabled in tauri.conf.json) so the drop reaches the page at all. No shell, filesystem, HTTP, clipboard, or broad core defaults, and no opener default either: the URL scope below is Hugging Face's pages and nothing else, so the webview cannot hand the platform a file, a program, or another site to open. No updater or process permission either, though the updater plugin is registered: its own check command takes a proxy, headers and a timeout from its caller, which would be an outbound request the page gets to address, so the check, the signature verification, the archive-version check, the install and the restart all happen in Rust. The Engine is spawned by Rust the webview cannot address, and the commands the webview can reach (engine_status, engine_config, engine_retry, open_audio_folder, open_data_folder, reveal_logs, update_status, update_install, open_download_page) take no arguments, so there is nothing in them to steer. open_audio_folder reveals the one folder Exports land in - Readily in Documents - making it first if needed, open_data_folder one folder the Rust side computes for itself - Readily's own data directory - and reveal_logs one file inside it - the log a reader sends with a bug report - and no path or program name crosses the boundary to say which. No log permission either, though the log plugin is registered for the Rust side's writer: its JS command would let the page write lines into that file, which is the one file designed never to hold a Source. update_install installs only a release the built-in endpoint and minisign public key agree on whose signed bundle version is newer than the running build, and no version, URL or host crosses the boundary to say which. open_download_page opens one https page compiled into the binary - Readily's download page, for a release a Linux package cannot install itself - through the opener plugin's Rust API, which this scope does not govern.
